text: the 'why its built this way' is a bad way to frame it. it isnt built that way. well, ok it is built that way but the logic behind it is a complete misunderstanding of how to retain edit history. why would the edits i made in a session, need recapture EVERYTHING for the sole edit? especially when, i have no actual ability to do the following: make edits -> quit the app -> restart it -> ctrl z; all of that history is inaccessible to me
